params.body:
The "Handleiding toevoegen" form was one of the last screens on the old markup: a `divide-y` line under each row and above the button, a `shadow` card, and inputs with the forms-plugin border, which `docs/design-system.md` says the fields switch off because the two outlines draw on top of each other. Two fields came out as a stack of grey lines.

- The form now uses `x-form.form`, `x-form.row` and `x-form.input` in a card with `ring-1 ring-ink-200`, like "Complementair vak aanmaken". Labels "Naam" and "Link", the link field is `type="url"`, and the header links back to "Alle handleidingen".
- The manuals index checked `hasRole('dmin|superadmin')`. The routes let admins in, but only a superadmin saw "Handleiding toevoegen" and "Handleiding beheren". Fixed to `admin|superadmin`.
- `AddingAManualTest`: an admin sees both buttons, a teacher does not, the form has no dividers and asks for a url, saving lists the manual.

Checked by rendering the page with the built assets at 1280 and 390 px wide.

Tests: the new test passes (4 tests). The full suite on the workbench has 20 failures, all from the set a plain `origin/main` fails there (Chrome printing, BuildStamp, report PDFs).
params.title: Put the add-a-manual form on the shared form components
